paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: local voice - click-to-talk dictation (faster-whisper), spoken commands and read-aloud (
Piper), fully offline
# dsh-voice

Local voice for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): dictate your
messages and have answers read aloud, entirely

eepSeek Harness (DSH): dictate your
messages and have answers read aloud, entirely on your computer.
> **Maintenance: best-effort.** Issues may go unanswered; forks are welcome.
## What it adds
- **Dictation**: a microphone button next to *Send*. Click to talk, click again to stop (10 minutes

at most). The page converts the recording to a 16 kHz WAV, the host transcribes it with
faster-whisp

er (`small` model, CPU, int8; French or
English detected) and the text is added to the message box.

It is **never sent by itself**.
- **Spoken commands**: a dictation that starts with "command …" / "c

ommande …" becomes the matching
slash command or skill of the session ("command web on" → `/web on`,

"command science reading …"
→ `/science-reading …`). Unknown names are left as text, with a notice.

- **Read aloud**: a *Read* button under each answer, spoken by a local Piper
voice (French or Engli

sh, guessed from the text). Code blocks are skipped.
- **Never** a wake word or an always-on microph

one: the browser opens the microphone on your click
and releases it when the recording stops.

The interface is in English, and in French when DSH's language is French (tables `en` and `fr` at
th
e top of `client.js`).

is on npm, `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice` works too.

2. The voice tools, once (Python 3.10 or later, about 1 GB on disk with the models). The default
fol
der is `~/.dsh/tools/voice` (`<DSH_HOME>/tools/voice`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The last two commands download the models from the internet (Hugging Face); this is the only
time an
ything is downloaded. Afterwards the worker runs offline.
3. Restart the profile. Your browser asks for the microphone on the first dictation.
## Configuration
All options have defaults; set them on the `voice` row of the profile:
| Option | Default | Meaning |

| `python` | `<DSH_HOME>/tools/voice/bin/python` | Python of the voice virtual environment |
| `mode

lsDir` | `<DSH_HOME>/tools/voice/models` | folder with `whisper/` and `piper/` |
| `whisperModel` |

`small` | faster-whisper model size (multilingual: `base`, `small`, `medium`…) |
| `voiceFr`, `voice
En` | `fr_FR-siwis-medium`, `en_US-lessac-medium` | Piper voices (`<modelsDir>/piper/<voice>.onnx`)

|
| `hotwords` | `commande command DeepSeek DSH Ollama Piper Whisper` | words Whisper should spell r

ight (names, jargon) |
| `threads` | `min(6, CPU threads)` | CPU threads of the worker |
| `idleMinu

tes` | `10` | the worker stops after this idle time (frees 1 to 2 GB of RAM) |
| `maxAudioMB` | `20`

| largest recording accepted (about 10 minutes) |
| `maxReadChars` | `8000` | longest text read alo

ecording accepted (about 10 minutes) |
| `maxReadChars` | `8000` | longest text read aloud at once |
Dictation and reading support French and English only.
## How it works

- `client.js` (page side) draws the microphone button and the *Read* buttons, records with the
brows

er's `MediaRecorder`, converts to a 16 kHz mono WAV and plays the answer audio.
- `index.js` (host s

ide) serves a small channel at `/voice-api/<stt|tts|to-command|warm>` and runs
one long-lived Python

worker (the Whisper model loads once), stopped after `idleMinutes`.
- `worker/voice_worker.py` read

s one JSON request per line and answers one JSON line: transcription
(faster-whisper; it reads the W

AV itself, PyAV is not used) or speech (Piper).
- `lib/commands.js` turns "command <name> …" into `/

name …` with the names of the session's commands
and skills. It is pure JavaScript, a port of native

code compared with it on 200,000 generated
cases with identical results.
## Compatibility
| Component | Supported |
n optional `peerDependency` on `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, the only DSH package the host side import

s |
| Platform | Linux (tested); the plugin itself is pure JavaScript, the worker is Python |
| Pyth

on tools | tested with Python 3.12, faster-whisper 1.2.1, piper-tts 1.8.0 |
| Browser | a browser wi

th `MediaRecorder` and Web Audio (current Chromium and Firefox) |
| Page | the chat page of DSH's we
b UI; the buttons are placed next to the *Send* and *Copy* buttons (found by their English or French
labels) and may need an update when the page changes |
## Permissions and external services
Everything the plugin can touch, and what happens when it fails:
| Capability | Where | Used for | If it fails |
| **Microphone** | `client.js` (`getUserMedia`) | only between your two clicks on the microphone but

ton; released right after | the page shows "microphone blocked or missing" |
| **Commands** | `index
.js` (`child_process.spawn`) | starts `python -I worker/voice_worker.py` with a minimal environment
(`PATH`, `HOME`, offline Hugging Face flags, thread count), in a temporary folder; stopped when idle
or when DSH stops | dictation and reading show the error ("voice tools are not installed" when the

Python is missing) |
| **Files** | `index.js`, worker | writes each recording and each spoken answer
as a WAV in a temporary folder and deletes it after use; reads the models from `modelsDir` | the re

quest fails with an error message |
| **Network** | none at run time | the worker runs with `HF_HUB_
OFFLINE=1` and `local_files_only`; only the one-time install commands above download models | n/a |
| **HTTP route** | `index.js` (`ctx.webServer.register`) | `POST /voice-api/<method>` for the page,
behind `ctx.connection.admit()` (DSH's Host/Origin fence and token); audio limited to `maxAudioMB`,

JSON bodies to 1 MiB | non-admitted requests get 401/403; other errors are returned as JSON |
| **Se
ssion data** | `index.js` (`ctx.commands`, `ctx.skills`, `ctx.agents`) | reads the names of the sess
ion's commands and skills, to recognise spoken commands; nothing is written | the dictation stays pl

skills, to recognise spoken commands; nothing is written | the dictation stays plain text |
